name: pro.foxify/agent-commerce
title: FOXIFY Agent Commerce
description: Preflight agent payments/actions before execution: ALLOW, REVIEW or DENY with evidence.

tools.name: foxify_preflight_info
tools.description: Free metadata for FOXIFY machine-payable authority preflight tools.

tools.name: verify_agent_payment_intent
tools.description: Paid transaction preflight. Checks mandate, amount, destination, merchant, expiry and replay risk before an autonomous payment executes. Costs $0.05 USDC on Base.

agent.description: Optional caller agent metadata. Assertions are advisory unless independently verified.

signature_verified.description: Whether the caller asserts that the agent signature was verified before this preflight.

domain.description: Merchant domain the payment is intended for.

expected_recipient.description: Optional merchant-side expected payment recipient for cross-checking.

merchant.description: Merchant identity and optional recipient expectation.

network.description: Payment network identifier, for example eip155:8453 for Base.

currency.description: Payment asset or currency symbol, for example USDC.

amount.description: Requested payment amount in the caller contract units.

recipient.description: Destination account or address that would receive the payment.

payment.description: Payment facts to compare with the caller authorization envelope.

max_amount.description: Maximum amount authorized by the caller mandate.

expected_recipient.description: Optional recipient required by the authorization boundary; compared with the requested payment recipient.

allowed_domains.description: Optional allowlist of merchant domains authorized for this payment.

human_confirmed.description: Whether the caller asserts that required human confirmation has occurred.

authorization.description: Caller-provided payment authorization boundary used for advisory comparison.

tools.name: verify_x402_payment_required
tools.description: Paid wire-bound x402 v2 preflight. Give FOXIFY the merchant's actual PAYMENT-REQUIRED challenge, exact intended HTTP request and independent caller authority; FOXIFY derives payment facts and returns advisory ALLOW, REVIEW or DENY evidence. Costs $0.05 USDC on Base.

payment_required.description: Raw x402 v2 PAYMENT-REQUIRED header value or its decoded object.

method.description: Exact HTTP method the buyer intends to execute.

url.description: Exact resource URL the buyer intends to execute.

intended_request.description: Exact HTTP request bound to the merchant x402 challenge.

accept_index.description: Explicit accepted-payment index when the challenge contains multiple eligible exact-USDC options.

signature_verified.description: Whether the caller asserts that its agent identity/signature was independently verified.

max_amount_atomic.description: Maximum atomic USDC amount independently authorized by the caller.

expected_recipient.description: Recipient required by caller authority; compared with the merchant challenge payTo.

allowed_domains.description: Merchant domains independently authorized by the caller.

allowed_payment_flows.description: Optional x402 payment-flow allowlist. Defaults to authorization only.

allowed_asset_transfer_methods.description: Optional EVM transfer-method allowlist. Defaults to eip3009 only.

human_confirmed.description: Whether the caller asserts that required human confirmation has occurred.

authorization.description: Independent caller authority. Merchant PAYMENT-REQUIRED facts never authorize themselves.

tools.name: verify_agent_action_intent
tools.description: Paid exact-action authority preflight for consequential agent tool calls. Binds subject, tool, operation, target, canonical parameters, authority lifetime, retries and postcondition requirements. Costs $0.25 USDC on Base.

id.description: Stable identifier for the agent or subject requesting the action.

identity_verified.description: Whether the caller asserts that the subject identity was verified.

subject.description: Subject identity facts for the requested action.

tool.description: Tool or capability that would perform the action.

operation.description: Exact operation or method requested on the tool.

consequence.description: Consequence class of the requested action.

id.description: Exact target identifier within that type.

parameters.description: Canonical caller-supplied action parameters to bind into the authority decision.

action.description: Exact consequential action being considered before execution.

expires_at.description: UTC ISO-8601 expiry of the authority grant.

subject_id.description: Subject identifier that the authority grant applies to.

attestation_verified.description: Whether the caller asserts that an authority attestation was independently verified.

allowed_tools.description: Tools permitted by the authority grant.

allowed_operations.description: Operations permitted by the authority grant.

id.description: Allowed target identifier within that type.

allowed_targets.description: Targets permitted by the authority grant.

expected_parameters_hash.description: Optional expected digest of canonical action parameters.

human_confirmation_required.description: Whether the authority grant requires a human confirmation step.

human_confirmed.description: Whether the caller asserts that the required human confirmation was completed.

max_attempts.description: Maximum execution attempts permitted by the authority grant.

allow_retry.description: Whether a retry is explicitly permitted by the authority grant.

postcondition_required.description: Whether authoritative postcondition verification is required after execution.

authority.description: Caller-provided authority envelope to compare against the requested action.

execution.description: Retry and prior-outcome state for this logical operation.

prior_outcome.description: Authoritative knowledge about any prior attempt outcome.

retry_authorized.description: Whether the caller explicitly authorizes this retry after reconciling prior outcome.

idempotency_key.description: Optional stable idempotency key for the logical operation.

postcondition.description: Expected authoritative postcondition contract for the action.

type.description: Type of postcondition that must be verified after execution.

authoritative_source.description: Provider or exact owner that can authoritatively confirm the postcondition.
